Profile: nextjs
Style: default
Intent: create
Phase id: contract-wiring
Phase task: Wire controls and data-anvil observability. Preserve or add data-anvil-action="primary" on the main start/submit/action control, data-anvil-action="input" on the main text entry surface when one exists, and data-anvil-state with a JSON snapshot of meaningful visible state. The data-anvil-state snapshot must include at least one dimension that immediately responds to input, such as the current selection or edited value. When the contract includes start_or_restart_flow, every restart affordance (including terminal and active states when present) should carry data-anvil-action="restart"; the initial primary action alone cannot satisfy recovery verification.

Profile generation rules:
- Profile nextjs/create: preserve a real Next.js app contract. Include next/react/react-dom dependencies, keep scripts.build as next build, and end with a build verification phase. Put dependency setup before any npm run build verification when node_modules is not already present; setup instructions may install dependencies, but verify must not contain npm install. If dependency setup is not allowed or cannot run, stop with dependency_missing instead of claiming build success. Keep a single route-bound implementation; do not leave capability components unimported. For interactive UI, implement the requested interface, replacing unrelated scaffold content, and preserve data-anvil-* attributes on route-bound UI: data-anvil-action="primary" on the main start/submit/action control, data-anvil-action="input" on the main text entry surface when one exists, and data-anvil-state with a JSON snapshot of meaningful visible state after each render. When the contract includes start_or_restart_flow, every restart affordance (including terminal and active states when present) should carry data-anvil-action="restart"; the initial primary action alone cannot satisfy recovery verification. A restart reachable during active use (hook or keyboard shortcut) allows behavioral verification, while an overlay-only restart may verify as unverified:terminal_state_not_reached (partial). If you use Tailwind utility classes or @tailwind directives, include tailwindcss/postcss/autoprefixer and create tailwind.config.* plus postcss.config.*; postcss.config plugins must include BOTH tailwindcss and autoprefixer. Otherwise use plain CSS and do not write Tailwind utility classes. Keep scripts.dev and scripts.start on the explicit requested port when the goal or plan requests one; otherwise use port 3011 with next dev/start -p 3011 or --port 3011.
- For TypeScript apps, put shared domain and request/response types in src/lib/types.ts and import the same types from page and route modules. Use imported helpers and export every function consumed by another module. Decide one JSON response shape per operation (bare array, {items}, or {item}) and make the UI read exactly what the route returns. Check Response.ok before accepting a mutation; return errors as {error, details?} and display them in the UI. Connect each requested UI action through its API to persistence and reload the committed result.
- For server-side file persistence, initialize only a missing file (ENOENT); distinguish valid empty data from missing data. Parse errors, directory replacement and other read or write I/O failures must return 5xx without overwriting any existing or related data. Serialize the complete read-modify-write transaction across all writers (including multiple processes), or use generation checks with conflict handling; write to a temporary file and atomically rename it. Atomic rename alone does not prevent lost updates.
- Validate the complete proposed state before committing: aggregate quantities by entity key before checking availability, scope totals to the requested period, define rejection/cascade/reassignment for referenced parent deletion, and match strict/inclusive comparisons to the goal wording. Reject non-finite or invalid quantities and amounts at the API boundary.

When the contract includes start_or_restart_flow, every restart affordance (including terminal and active states when present) should carry data-anvil-action="restart"; the initial primary action alone cannot satisfy recovery verification. A restart reachable during active use (hook or keyboard shortcut) allows behavioral verification, while an overlay-only restart may verify as unverified:terminal_state_not_reached (partial).
- Do not treat scaffold-only, package-only, or build-only output as complete.

steps.instruction: Read src/app/page.tsx to assess current data-anvil attribute coverage: check for data-anvil-action="primary", data-anvil-action="input", data-anvil-state JSON snapshot, and any restart affordances (data-anvil-action="restart"). Note which elements need wiring or re-wiring for the contract-wiring phase.

Edit src/app/page.tsx to ensure the following data-anvil attributes are present on the route-bound interactive UI: (1) data-anvil-action="primary" on the main submit/create button (e.g. the button that creates a project or adds a task). (2) data-anvil-action="input" on the main text entry surface (e.g. the task title or project name input). (3) data-anvil-state on the main container or status region containing a JSON.stringify snapshot of meaningful visible state that includes at least one dimension immediately responding to user input (e.g. current filter selection, edited title value, or task status count). (4) data-anvil-action="restart" on every restart affordance including terminal and active states (e.g. a reset/reload button or a hook-triggered restart). Preserve existing Next.js app router structure, imports from src/lib/types.ts, and API call patterns. The data-anvil-state JSON must be computed after each render and reflect the current selection or edited value.

Create smoke-check.js at the workspace root. The file must read src/app/page.tsx as a string and assert: (a) the string contains the literal data-anvil-action="primary" (check for the attribute with proper quoting), (b) it contains data-anvil-action="input", (c) it contains data-anvil-state, (d) it contains JSON.stringify or a JSON template literal referencing state, (e) it contains data-anvil-action="restart". Print 'all anvil checks pass' on success or throw an Error listing missing checks. Use fs.readFileSync with utf8 encoding. Do not use shell quoting; write plain JavaScript.
Run the smoke check to confirm all data-anvil attributes are wired in the source file.
Run the Next.js production build to confirm the application compiles successfully with the updated page.tsx and all data-anvil wiring in place.
